description: Aggem Thorncurse is a living quilboar shaman in Razorfen Kraul, bearing the title Death's Head Prophet. He calls a boar spirit to his aid when threatened.
intro: Aggem Thorncurse is a living quilboar shaman in Razorfen Kraul, bearing the title Death's Head Prophet. He calls a boar spirit to his aid when threatened.

p: Aggem guards a part of Razorfen Kraul occupied by the Death's Head tribe. His shamanic powers include summoning a boar spirit, reflecting the quilboar's reverence for Agamaggan.
